requirements.rule: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

requirements.rule: A percentage apprenticeship reduces every fixed allowance whose apprenticeship_pct_relevant flag the data leaves at its default, together with the base salary. Whether the CCNL applies the percentage to that allowance (an EDR, a contingenza, a function allowance) was not sourced. The run is affected when such an allowance is in the apprentice's pay.
requirements.remediation: Source, for each CCNL, the elements the apprenticeship percentage applies to and set apprenticeship_pct_relevant on every allowance; the limitation then no longer applies to its runs.

requirements.rule: The engine computes the rate of the separate taxation of arrears from PriorYearTaxFacts.net_income_biennio (art. 21 cc. 1, 3 TUIR) and reduces the tax by ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions, the deductions of artt. 12 and 13 cc. 1-2 the worker did not use in the years the arrears refer to (art. 21 c. 4). An arrears event that does not state them, among which the una tantum the engine pays itself, is taxed without the reduction, so the tax may be overstated.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.variable_pay.arrears.handlers._handle_arrears; art. 21 TUIR (Normattiva, text in force from 31-12-2024 to 31-12-2026, page sha256 9638f2c5aec6e3615193a672b6d07c3cd31083640b1c890b73022aa9951745f1)
requirements.remediation: State ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions from the worker's declaration of the deductions used each year; for the una tantum, carry it into the events the engine generates.

requirements.rule: A first- or third-level apprentice (D.Lgs. 81/2015 artt. 43 and 45) is paid by the CCNL dual_apprenticeship tracks, but the INPS contributions and the other rates of the run are those of the professionalising apprentice: the contribution regime of these apprentices is not sourced. On a final-settlement run that pays both its month and the ratei, Apprentice.hours splits both by one set of hours.
requirements.remediation: Source the INPS contribution regime of first- and third-level apprentices and apply it; give a final-settlement run separate hours for its month and its ratei.

requirements.rule: SICKNESS (Art. 66, PDF p. 78): the employer pays the elements 1-10 of Art. 44 (INPS pays no indemnity to the impiegati of industry). Modelled per illness: up to two years of seniority six months in full; from two to six years nine months, the last three at 50%; over six years twelve months, three at 75% and three at 50%; several illnesses or relapses keep the job 9, 12 or 15 months in 30. Not modelled: the pay of the three extra months of several illnesses ('intero trattamento economico per il primo mese e del 50% per i mesi restanti'): the text does not say whether they follow the aggregate of the illnesses or each illness's own period, so each illness takes its own schedule.
requirements.remediation: Settle how the three extra months of art. 66 are counted across illnesses, then pay them.

requirements.rule: Art. 65: the annual loyalty award is paid on the hire-anniversary month after 20 years of uninterrupted actual service, using the run-chain monthly pay as an approximation of Art. 44 items 1-15. Not modelled: the whole-month twelfths due after a non-disciplinary dismissal, conventional seniority and interruptions or group-company service not represented by the hire date, and the exact Art. 44 elements (including territorial and individual components) actually summed in the award.
requirements.remediation: Represent qualifying actual service and the Art. 44 items 1-15 individually, and pay whole-month twelfths on eligible non-disciplinary dismissal.

requirements.rule: Art. 43: the 1/25 for the festività of 4 November is paid with every November pay, as the quota of '11-04' on the first Sunday of November (work_rules.sunday_holidays, divisor 25), in addition to a holiday of art. 61 on the same Sunday. Approximated: the text owes it 'per il mese di novembre'; the engine pays it to a worker employed on the first Sunday of November, not to one hired after it or leaving before it.
requirements.remediation: Pay the 1/25 of art. 43 to every impiegato employed in November, whatever the first Sunday.

requirements.rule: Art. 54 excludes turnisti from the 50% night-holiday band; this exclusion is enforced. The same page states a 10% premium for night work in periodic shifts, covered by the existing ANCE_IMP_TURNO_NOTTURNO night_shift band (requested separately). No distinct combined night-holiday periodic-shift rate or stacking rule is stated: zero under the excluded 50% band is provisional, not total remuneration.
requirements.remediation: Determine whether the existing 10% periodic night-shift rate applies to these hours and how it combines with holiday pay before settling total remuneration.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2); a collective agreement, also of the company, that sets other hours to a day of leave or other rules of cumulation prevails, and the bundle holds none.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Art. 46: the EVR set by the provincial agreements.
requirements.remediation: Add the provincial EVR as an input.

requirements.rule: Mensa, trasporto and trasferta, set by the provincial agreements (verbale 2025).
requirements.remediation: Add the provincial mensa, trasporto and trasferta as inputs.

requirements.rule: PREMIO DI PRODUZIONE: the premio di produzione set by the provincial agreements (Art. 44 n. 5) is owed to every impiegato; the engine reads no provincial agreement. Not modelled: the net pay and the employer cost are short of it.
requirements.remediation: Model the provincial premio di produzione with a fact naming the province, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: Art. 76: the absorption of a superminimo into the quadri function allowance. The una tantum premio di ingresso of the verbale of 3 March 2022 and the riduzione contributiva edile concern the operai only.

Artt. 47 and 52: the 25% special allowance for directors with responsibility for a company or department also depends on the unmodelled provincial production premium (and the option to deduct it from a superminimo set for those duties); the mountain and compressed-air caisson treatment depends on the operai's territorial rates; the EUR 25.82 monthly tunnel allowance is absorbed by same-purpose payments and by existing superminimi not granted for merit or another specific reason. Art. 50 cash handling with liability for errors is paid at 8% of minimum plus ex-contingenza when the role is attested.
requirements.remediation: Source the provincial production premium and the operai's rates, and represent the specified superminimo absorption before paying the remaining allowances of Artt. 47 and 52.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: The una tantum of a renewal is paid from the CCNL data with readings no text read settles in full: a month of service in the covered period counts with the days of the una tantum (15 when the text is silent), over the months of the period; the absences of a month do not reduce it, though a text may pay the months 'di effettiva prestazione'; a part time is paid in proportion to its hours; a run without the employment period is paid none; the share of the covered months of earlier years is taxed apart as arrears.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.una_tantum.rules.una_tantum_events; CCNL agenti immobiliari FIAIP 19 May 2025 art. 163 (pp. 97-98, sha256 560d16410d3e41dc0bfb00bfe2a40ef65f2cd900234aeaee92018ed9fa21ead5)
requirements.remediation: Source the counting of the months, the part time and the taxation of each una tantum from its agreement, then resolve this limitation.
